text: The closest I can come to finding something that looks different is panel number 3, middle top and I say that because the blue box on the top is substantially bigger than any other blue panel, it's also bigger than any other pink panel, they're not quite as much bigger than the one on the bottom right, it's pink, but it's still the biggest one. There may be a pattern in there somewhere, but without spending an hour and a half looking for it, that's what I come up with.
